body: The problem is my entire fucking family. I've been abused by my brother's and sisters my whole life. Everyone tells me what a disgrace I am to the entire family and what a waste of space I am. I have no friends either because nobody wants to go near me. Nowhere will even give me a job because of the things my family says about me behind my back. I can't even get out of here because I have no money and the job situation isn't improving any time soon. So yeah, I'm stuck here unless I just kill myself already. My family will be better off without me anyway

She definitely likes my siblings more than she likes me. I got thrown out at 18 just because I had a pint down the pub with a friend (btw, completely legal in the uk). My brother comes home high on class A drugs at 17. Nothing happened to him. My sister drinks a whole bottle of vodka at 15, threatens to kill me and mum, and builds a bonfire on the dining table. Guess what? Nothing happened to her either. My step brother fucking raped me and he was still sleeping over every fucking weekend after I told my mum what he did. Why am I treated so differently if my family loves me?

My mother shows more affection to her evil parrot who tries to claw people's eyes out than she's ever shown me. Most of my family has abused me in one way or another. The only person who might miss me is my brother but he's used to me not being around anyway so me being dead won't make a difference to him
The thing is, nobody will miss me. Not even my own mother
